dsp GenSubTriBassBp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 1800.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.1
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.7003

dsp GenSubTriLeadLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.9
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6306

dsp GenSubTriPadLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0)) + (1.0 - abs(ph1 * 4.0 - 2.0)) + (1.0 - abs(ph2 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 0.333333 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.3) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.3
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6656

dsp GenSubTriPadHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0)) + (1.0 - abs(ph1 * 4.0 - 2.0)) + (1.0 - abs(ph2 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 0.333333 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.3) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.3
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 1.3 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 3.0000

subTriPluckHp.source:
dsp GenSubTriPluckHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 0.7 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 2.5445

subTriBrassLp.source:
dsp GenSubTriBrassLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := ((1.0 - abs(ph0 * 4.0 - 2.0)) + (1.0 - abs(ph1 * 4.0 - 2.0))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6551

dsp GenSubSyncBassLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 1800.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.1
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.5487

subSyncBassBp.source:
dsp GenSubSyncBassBp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.003 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 1800.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.1
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.4716

subSyncLeadHp.source:
dsp GenSubSyncLeadHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.01 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.9
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 0.9 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 0.5132

dsp GenSubSyncPadLp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.6 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.2 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.994 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)
    set ph2 := fract(ph2 + dt2)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(ph1 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(ph2 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 0.333333 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (300.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.3) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.3
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.5756

  state previous : F32 := 0.0

  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0

    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)

    let dt2 := min(0.4, f * 1.006 / sr)

    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))

    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f

    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate

dsp GenSubSyncPluckBp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 1.0 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 1.0 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 0.7
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.4802

    let kf := 1.2

    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v2f) * 0.9) * 0.5650

dsp GenSubSyncBrassBp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(ph1 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1f * 1.6) * 0.9) * 0.5063

subSyncBrassHp.source:
dsp GenSubSyncBrassHp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state ph0 : F32 := 0.0
  state ph1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state fenv : F32 := 0.0
  state sp : F32 := 0.0
  state i1f : F32 := 0.0
  state i2f : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let fenvA := select(trigger, gate, fenv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.25 * sr)))
    set fenv := fenvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    let dt0 := min(0.4, f * 0.997 / sr)
    set ph0 := fract(ph0 + dt0)
    let dt1 := min(0.4, f * 1.003 / sr)
    set ph1 := fract(ph1 + dt1)
    let raw := (sinpi(ph0 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0)) + sinpi(ph1 * 2.0 * (1.5 + colour * 3.0))) * 0.5 * envA
    let gf := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, (120.0 + (colour * 0.6 + fenvA * 0.7) * 5200.0)) / sr))
    let kf := 1.2
    let af := 1.0 / (1.0 + gf * (gf + kf))
    let v1f := af * (i1f + gf * (raw - i2f))
    let v2f := i2f + gf * v1f
    set i1f := 2.0 * v1f - i1f
    set i2f := 2.0 * v2f - i2f
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((raw - 1.2 * v1f - v2f) * 0.9) * 0.6027

dsp GenOrganFullPlainStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.333333 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6862

dsp GenOrganFullPlainTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.333333 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6880

dsp GenOrganFullPlainChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state h5 : F32 := 0.0
  state h6 : F32 := 0.0
  state h7 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h5 := fract(h5 + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    set h6 := fract(h6 + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    set h7 := fract(h7 + min(0.45, f * 6.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h5 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h6 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h7 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.333333 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6983

organJazzPlainTremolo.source:
dsp GenOrganJazzPlainTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.57735 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6036

organJazzPercTremolo.source:
dsp GenOrganJazzPercTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.57735 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6031

dsp GenOrganGospelPlainTremolo where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 6.7 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.447214 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6326

organGospelPlainChorale.source:
dsp GenOrganGospelPlainChorale where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.8 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.447214 * envA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6747

organGospelPercStill.source:
dsp GenOrganGospelPercStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state h0 : F32 := 0.0
  state h1 : F32 := 0.0
  state h2 : F32 := 0.0
  state h3 : F32 := 0.0
  state h8 : F32 := 0.0
  state h4 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state pe : F32 := 0.0
  state lfo : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.006 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let peA := select(trigger, gate, pe * expneg(5.0 / (0.3 * sr)))
    set pe := peA
    set lfo := fract(lfo + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set h4 := fract(h4 + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set h0 := fract(h0 + min(0.45, f * 0.5 / sr))
    set h1 := fract(h1 + min(0.45, f * 1.5 / sr))
    set h2 := fract(h2 + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set h3 := fract(h3 + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set h8 := fract(h8 + min(0.45, f * 8.0 / sr))
    let tone := (sinpi(h0 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h1 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h2 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h3 * 2.0) * 1.0 + sinpi(h8 * 2.0) * 1.0) * 0.447214 * envA + sinpi(h4 * 2.0) * peA * 0.4
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((tone * (1.0 - 0.0 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sinpi(lfo * 2.0))) * (0.7 + colour * 0.3)) * 0.8) * 0.6295
